reason: A knowledge-management plugin that imports and processes documents, builds local searchable knowledge bases with hybrid retrieval, and provides model tools plus a management panel.

summaries.zh: 用于创建和管理知识库、导入并处理文档、构建混合检索索引，并通过模型工具和管理面板访问知识内容。
summaries.en: A knowledge-management plugin for importing and processing documents, building hybrid-search knowledge bases, and accessing their content through model tools and an administration panel.

capabilities: Creates, updates, deletes, and organizes local knowledge bases and documents
Reads and processes imported files, directories, URLs, and text content
Stores document chunks and metadata in local JSON and SQLite storage
Performs local embedding, reranking, OCR, and document processing in worker threads
Can connect to configured external embedding, reranking, MinerU, Ollama, and model-download services
Exposes model-facing tools for knowledge search, document management, import, reading, statistics, and reindexing
